subject: Air freight quote request – LOS
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Could you please quote the fastest air freight option to LOS (Lagos, NG)? The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-27 at our site in postcode 36272 (Fulda), Germany. Please arrange truck transport from our site to the departure airport.

The shipment consists of 11 pieces of machine parts, with a gross weight of 1162 kg and a volume of 4.45 cbm.

Please provide an all-in price in EUR, including pickup, and confirm the earliest possible arrival at LOS.

Thank you.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in air freight quote for a new shipment to Lagos.
